faq.q: What is the best time to visit Matheran?
faq.a: The best time to visit Matheran is Oct – May. Summers are 20–32°C and winters are 12–24°C.

The nearest airport is Matheran / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Kalyan Junction (Mumbai) (32 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.a: 2 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Matheran at a relaxed pace.

faq.a: The top attractions are Panorama Point, Matheran Toy Train, Charlotte Lake.
